reviews.text: I called one morning and within two days they came and my roof and gutters were brighter and clean. They made sure to rinse all the trees around my house after applying the soft washing solution. Very thorough and a worry free experience. Had no idea I had so much moss in my gutters! Appreciated all the advice Mike offered for proper roof maintenance. A+

My experience with NJ Power Cleaners was great. Mike came out within a day of me calling and gave me an estimate. He was knowledgeable about what the appropriate treatment was for my issue and was very flexible in the scheduling. The results were so good I asked him to come back and soft wash some other areas of the property and those came out great as well. Would definitely recommend! Thank you!

This company is amazing!  Very professional and responsive.  We called to request a quote and within hours Mike came to our house.  He explained everything that would be done....and their prices are unbelievable.  Mike and his crew did an exceptional job.  Oh, he came the next day after quoting us, on a Sunday, to do the job.  We couldn't be happier!!  We highly recommend NJ Power Cleaners....you won't be disappointed!
